liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Big Railroad Blues** (3 reviews): Bruce Hornsby's playing pushes Jerry higher on this version, per the listener; Solo spots pass between band members smoothly and easily [11][14][19]
- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Opener with Hornsby playing strongly; named among first-set standouts; Reviewer calls it the tightest, most rocking Jack Straw the Dead ever played [16][17]
- **Cassidy** (2 reviews): The jams in Cassidy are described as exceptionally on target; Cassidy lifts the energy further, with explosive jamming in an already fiery first set [13][14]
- **Wang Dang Doodle** (1 review): Described as a party-feeling performance [14]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Lighting was soft for Row Jimmy, then turned harsh for Black Throated Wind [19]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China into Rider is very energetic, with an especially funky transition jam into Rider [16]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Described as very spiritual [11]

## The recordings

- **gd91-06-06.naks.jamphan.11604.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd91-06-06.sbd.miller.18711.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 157 min; rated 4.08/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sound quality is described as great; Of three circulating recordings of this night, this soundboard is said to sound best [16][18]
- **gd1991-06-06.149524.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 19 songs; 162 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd91-06-06.dsbd.chastewk.478.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 158 min; rated 4.21/5 by 29 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound nice, with Big Railroad Blues shining [21]
- **gd1991-06-06.140482.TSBeyerCM1010.ebel.flac2496**: source not stated; 19 songs; 163 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [8]

## Around the show

- Listener attended; the crowd made local news because of illegal camping [11]
- Reviewer was on the boards; the band looked happy, smiling throughout the second set [19]
- Two keyboard players work well here; Jerry remains sharp and prominent in the mix [21]
- China Cat into Rider is judged equal to the 4/1/90 version, possibly better [13]
- Reviewer considers this show solid and underrated [13]
- Reviewer says the next night is slightly better; the two shows should be paired [22]
- Band sounded completely different from the Los Angeles show just before this one [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-06-06.naks.jamphan.11604.sbeok.shnf**: source: Nakamichi 300 shotguns, back tapers lawn > Sony D-6 (Denon Hd8-100 masters output from same deck) > Sony ES-59 DAT [1]
- **gd91-06-06.sbd.miller.18711.sbeok.shnf**: source: Recording Info:SBD -> Dat -> Cm -> DatTransfer Info:Dat -> Behringer UltraMatch SRC2000 -> Dio 2448 -> Samplitude v.60 -> Cool Edit Pro v1.2 -> CD -> EAC… [2]
- **gd1991-06-06.149524.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 12, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [3]. Also: The opening of China Cat Sunflower was patched from a separate DAT source [3]
- **gd91-06-06.dsbd.chastewk.478.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD -> 48 KHz DAT Read in by Other1: DigiI/O via SGI DAT drive ->shn file -> internet to chastewk -> unshned -> sample rate conversion andnormalization with… [7]
- **gd1991-06-06.140482.TSBeyerCM1010.ebel.flac2496**: taped by Pete Ebel; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac24 96khz Source Info: TS Beyer CM 101-> Sony D6-> Cassette Master (Maxell XL-II's 90's). Transfer Info: Master Cassette-> Nakamichi CR-5A -> Grace Lunatec… [8]. Also: AKG 451 audio fills the tape flip after Black Throated Wind in set one; China Cat's start was patched because the master tape seemed damaged; another tape flip occurs during Drumz [8]
